info.title: UniverAcademy atomic Telegram entry review
info.description: Review-only default-disabled operation. Both identities and profile/session/link/replay commit atomically. Activation requires replacing old Telegram two-step fallback and actual account-choice/reverification UX.

post.description: Server verifies raw Telegram launch HMAC/freshness and signed Clerk JWT with recent first-factor verification. Caller must visibly choose and confirm the Clerk account; cached session presence alone is not consent. No client identity IDs accepted. Existing Telegram ownership conflict is rejected before provisioning.

200.description: Session/profile returned only after one successful database commit. Response envelope data with access_token, refresh_token, expires_at, refresh_expires_at, token_type Bearer and profile. No-store.

403.description: Reverification required, disabled account or denied origin

409.description: Identity ownership conflict or consumed launch/token replay. No partial provisioning.

422.description: Invalid shape; no identity overrides accepted

503.description: Unconfirmed result. Do not presume rollback or create another profile; reconcile through existing authenticated resume.
